subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw officially own, publish, document, and support the Pioneer provider package, or should only the generic external-provider catalog seam land in core while Pioneer remains vendor-owned?
rationale: Code review can assess the implementation, but it cannot commit the project to a new official provider, package namespace, release obligation, credential flow, and dependency graph without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split generic seam from provider
options.body: Land the provider-agnostic external live-catalog support separately and move the Pioneer package to a vendor-owned repository or ClawHub distribution.

options.title: Sponsor the official provider
options.body: Accept OpenClaw ownership, authorize the dependency graph for the exact head, and require fresh-install, upgrade, live listing, and inference proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the integration
options.body: Close or pause this PR if neither official ownership nor a generic core catalog change is currently desired.

recommendation.title: Split generic seam from provider
recommendation.body: Land the provider-agnostic external live-catalog support separately and move the Pioneer package to a vendor-owned repository or ClawHub distribution.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice determines official package ownership and repository-level provider product direction.
